profiles.name: Killoren
speciesTraits: Medium Fey with 30-ft. land speed. Hit Dice come from character classes. Use the first-level class progression with no racial ability-score adjustment. Humanoid-only effects such as charm person and hold person do not apply.
Low-light vision retains color and detail and reaches twice human distance in dim light. Immune to magical sleep. +2 racial bonus on saving throws against enchantment spells and effects.
+2 racial bonus to Handle Animal and Survival. Cold Iron Anathema (Su) imposes −2 on attack rolls with wholly or partly cold-iron weapons, including attacks using cold-iron arrows.

Manifest Nature’s Might (Su): choose one aspect after 10 minutes of quiet meditation at sunrise. That aspect remains active until the next morning. The catalog choices are reference views of the same species.
Common and Sylvan are automatic. Bonus languages Aquan, Auran, Elven, Gnome, Ignan, Terran. Favored class Druid.
Aging thresholds are middle age at 30 and old age at 100. Killoren have no venerable stage or maximum age.

Aspect of the Ancient: add a racial bonus to Knowledge (nature) equal to Hit Dice. Gain another +2 on saves against enchantments, stacking with the usual +2 for a total racial bonus of +4. Hair is white and eyes sky blue.

Optional Killoren Ancient feat from p. 151: after 10 minutes of uninterrupted communion over a specific question, make any Knowledge check with +4 insight. On success it yields information as a trained check would, even if you lack ranks.

Aspect of the Destroyer: choose a smite attack at most once per hour, with a daily cap equal to your Charisma bonus (minimum 1). Add the Charisma bonus to the attack and +1 damage per Hit Die. Valid targets are aberrations, constructs, humanoids, oozes, outsiders, and undead. An ineligible target still uses the hourly and daily use. Hair and eyes become lusterless black.
Optional Killoren Destroyer feat from p. 151: a foe hit by an eligible smite must make a Will save (DC 10 + half character level, rounded down, + Charisma modifier) or become dazed for 1 round.

npcBuilds.name: Daranvar

build.title: Destroyer Killoren grove steward, Fighter 1
traits: Chain shirt +4 and Dexterity +1. Touch 11, flat-footed 14. BAB +1, grapple +3. Fortitude +3, Reflex +1, Will −1.

Low-light vision, magical sleep immunity, +2 racial saves against enchantments, +2 racial Handle Animal and Survival. The listed weapons use ordinary materials. Apply −2 to attacks using wholly or partly cold-iron weapons, including cold-iron arrows.
Destroyer is Daranvar’s active aspect. Weapon Focus (longspear) is the Fighter bonus feat. The Killoren Destroyer feat can daze a foe hit by an eligible smite.
actions: Longspear +4 melee, 1d8+3 piercing, critical ×3, reach 10 ft., usable against foes beyond adjacent squares. Club +3 melee adjacent, 1d6+2 bludgeoning one-handed, critical ×2.

Destroyer smite twice per day, at most once per hour. Smite with longspear +6 for 1d8+4 or club +5 for 1d6+3. Valid targets are aberrations, constructs, humanoids, oozes, outsiders, and undead. An invalid target spends the use.
On a successful smite against an eligible target, Killoren Destroyer requires Will DC 12 or dazes that target for 1 round.
build.tactics: Keep the construct on the path and away from the seedlings while the party looks for its control mark. Hold the crossing with the longspear. Save the smite for a clear hit on the construct.

npcBuilds.role: Destroyer aspect. Grove threshold steward and Fighter.
npcBuilds.motive: Keep a stray construct out of a seedling grove while a druid finds its control mark.
npcBuilds.hook: Daranvar can hold the crossing while the party checks the construct for its maker’s mark.

Aspect of the Hunter: +2 racial bonus to Hide, Listen, Move Silently, Spot, and initiative checks. Hair and eyes turn deep forest green and skin takes on a deeper brown tone.
Optional Killoren Hunter feat from p. 151: use a move action to pinpoint a living creature within 30 ft. if you have line of effect. A creature you cannot see retains total concealment.

npcBuilds.name: Irimel

build.title: Hunter Killoren trail ward, Rogue 1
traits: Leather armor +2 and Dexterity +2. Touch 12, flat-footed 12. BAB +0, grapple +0. Fortitude +1, Reflex +4, Will +0.

Low-light vision, magical sleep immunity, +2 racial saves against enchantments, +2 racial Handle Animal and Survival. The listed weapons use ordinary materials. Apply −2 to attacks using wholly or partly cold-iron weapons, including cold-iron arrows.
Hunter is Irimel’s active aspect for this encounter. Initiative, Hide, Listen, Move Silently, and Spot already include the Hunter +2.
Killoren Hunter feat can pinpoint a living creature within 30 ft. as a move action, with line of effect. An unseen creature keeps total concealment.

Trapfinding permits searching for traps with a DC above 20 and using Disable Device on magical traps. The kit includes ordinary thieves’ tools. Sneak Attack +1d6 applies to eligible attacks, with a 30-ft. limit for ranged attacks.
actions: Rapier +0 melee, 1d6 piercing, critical 18–20/×2, reach 5 ft.
Shortbow +2 ranged, 1d6 piercing, critical ×3, 60-ft. range increment.
build.tactics: Search the marked path for old alarms and keep travellers off the flooded stretch. If a living creature moves nearby in the fog, pinpoint it before asking anyone to approach.

npcBuilds.role: Hunter aspect. Fog trail ward and Rogue.
npcBuilds.motive: Guide the last group of travellers around a flooded stretch before the markers go under.
npcBuilds.hook: Irimel can find old warning lines and pinpoint someone calling from the fog if the party keeps the trail open.
